summary: Iteration 60: Trainer Profile Personality Redesign Testing Complete. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Verified Highlight Reel CRUD endpoints (GET/POST/DELETE), Music Search API (iTunes proxy), Vibe CRUD endpoints (PUT/DELETE), and auth requirements. Static code analysis confirms all new frontend components exist with expected features including shimmer animations, glow orbs, press feedback, cinematic entrance animations, and RapidReps logo placement.

PUT /api/trainer-profiles/{userId}/vibe.description: Saves vibe data with auth, returns 200

DELETE /api/trainer-profiles/{userId}/vi.description: Clears vibe data with auth, returns 200
